text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—M-Maybe I should just head home~...? It's 
kind of getting chilly~...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It might even feel a bit hot and humid. 
...It's about time you cast away your 
fear.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Leaving snacks behind at a bus stop is... 
totally unacceptable. While the chances of 
them being intact are low, I must verify.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Now she's all fired up in the worst way 
possible! I asked the wrong person—
(Rustle... rustle, rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...!? D-D-D-Did you hear something!? Could 
it be, a gho—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. Such things do not exist. 
...That sound came from over there, didn't 
it?
(Rustle...)
TOACHAAAAAAA!! HA-AAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Hey you, you ghost!! If you disrupt 
public morals in this neighborhood, I 
won't show any mercy!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Let us see if my Kongo Yaegaki style works 
on ghosts! Face me!! ...Wait, I sense a 
life force...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—...Ack, are you trying to kill me?! My 
heart seriously stopped right there!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. Bamboo was raging about a 
'ghost appearing'... so I got a bit 
carried away too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Because that's where disciplinary disorder 
begins! Man, I knew going on patrol was 
the right call!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing this late?! Don't tell 
me you guys are behind the 'dragging' 
sound...?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"*Scrape-drag*"...? It seems to be just 
onomatopoeia, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's not it! Lately, there's been a 
rumor around here about a sound dragging 
across the ground night after night—
(Drag... drag...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo & Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Nghhh!?!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...It's coming from the sea. It might 
really be a ghost this time. En garde!
(*tap-tap-tap... scuff*)
Maaarvelooouuus!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!!! IT'S HEEEEEEERE!!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? More customers~♪ Adding more bamboo 
was definitely the right move~.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing☆ The Night Sky Nagashi Somen 
Tournament is maxed out on marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is... The bamboo intricately 
weaves in every direction... What a 
magnificent piece.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I've solved the mystery of the 
'scrape-drag'! It was the sound of Akebono 
and the others dragging bamboo night after 
night to build a flowing somen slide."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Now's not the time for chatting! This is 
clearly a nuisance! No way, I'm shutting 
this down~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Got the OK from the Chairwoman~♪ Besides, 
'everyone' can't wait any longer, right?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Your "fifth member" is drooling right 
behind you ★ Look, right back there...
